name: Oscuridad de Fosas Nasales
algorithm: Nostril Darkness — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes nostril darkness and rendering for deepfake detection:

1. **Nostril Detección**: The nostrils are detected per frame as dark interior regions visible at the base of the nose. Their shape (typically oval), size, and darkness level are measured.

2. **Darkness Level Análisis**: Natural nostrils show very low luminance (dark cavity) with specific spectral properties (warm dark due to skin back-scattering). The method measures nostril darkness and compares against expected values. AI generators may produce nostrils that are: too bright (failing to render the cavity), too uniform (lacking internal light gradients), or with incorrect color temperature.

3. **Bilateral Simetría**: Left and right nostrils should be approximately symmetric in size and darkness (adjusted for head pose). The method checks bilateral nostril consistency. AI generators may produce asymmetric nostrils or nostrils that change relative size between frames.

4. **Pose - Dependent Visibility**: Nostril visibility changes predictably with head pitch — looking up shows more nostril interior, looking down hides them. The method verifies that nostril appearance changes correctly with estimated head pose. Incorrect pose-dependent nostril rendering indicates AI generation.

5. **Temporal Nostril Estabilidad**: Nostril dark regions should maintain consistent shape and position across frames (nostrils don't move relative to nose). The method tracks nostril features over time. Frame-to-frame nostril instability — changing shape, flickering darkness, shifting position — indicates per-frame independent rendering.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante nostril darkness analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
